DV24 Weaponstech to fit, and it never comes out. Costs twice the base weapon (1,000eb minimum). No Autofire, Suppressive Fire or bursts; BODY requirements +3; working the bolt after each shot takes an Action (ROF is unchanged). Its ammo costs double, a category higher, and fits only this gun. In return: +2d6 on Single Shots and shells, and past 25m, +1 to hit against DV21+ (+2 against DV24+).

Cost: x2 Base Weapon Cost [Minimum 1,000eb]
Fits: All Ranged Weapons that only fire Bullets, Slugs, and/or Shells
